description: With the offset at the +4 F cap, a door/window opens for 120 s inside a 300 s debounce and closes again. The offset is FROZEN: no reset to 66 F, no write, no flapping (owner decision D1).

events.note: The hallway thermostat's own sensor: satisfied, so it will not start by itself.
Seed the door/window sensor as closed.
Day classification (cold: heat all night / hot: cool all night).
Bedtime: the sleep band is written and the sleep window (remote sensor in use) begins.
Bedroom keeps reporting while the window is open inside the debounce.
It closes after 120 s, inside the debounce: nothing happened.

assertions.reason: Precondition: the offset is at the +4 F cap before the door opens.
A window open for 120 s inside a 300 s debounce changes NOTHING: no reset to 66, no write, no flapping (owner decision D1 = FREEZE).
The held offset is still what the thermostat has.
The window really was seen open and closed by the real coordinator listener (so the freeze was exercised, not skipped).

notes: Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md section 10), Issue #1194 increment (e). Tier A: the real ClimateAdvisorCoordinator + AutomationEngine under FakeHass/FakeScheduler (use_coordinator=true, so the sleep-sensor listener and the 1-minute timer are real); every assertion is track=integration for that reason and is evaluated, not skipped.

(a) Effectiveness: scratch-copy mutation run of this scenario against the production code (worktree untouched). It FAILS when M01: the whole offset deleted (the write path adds 0 and the check is a no-op); M02: the +4 F cap removed; M06: FREEZE treated as CLOSED (a debounce blip resets the offset). Passes unmutated.

(b) Docs <-> production alignment: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Remote-sensor outer loop on the thermostat setpoint (Issue #1194, increment a)': 'Gates' FREEZE rows and 'Debounce: FREEZE (owner decision D1)'. Matches production.
(c) Occupant outcome if this regressed: A door that opens for 20 s every few minutes must not flap the setpoint 66 <-> 68 F dozens of times an hour (measured 40/h with the earlier raw-open gate).

verdict.summary: A busy door does not move the setpoint (FREEZE inside the debounce).
verdict.observed_behavior: No setpoint write at all between the cap (20:35:59) and the end; the thermostat still holds 70 F.
verdict.expected_behavior: Held exactly as is inside the debounce; no loop write.
